reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM. Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

- **Sources:** the amendment itself says 185. In #north-team on 2025-08-20, Dana first wrote 180 and corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Dana is a member of that channel, so she can see both messages.
- **Also for the deck:** Amendment No. 3 was signed on 2026-09-22 and raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. Until then, 185 is still the count in effect.

Seat counts and dates are operational facts, so Dana can have them without anyone's approval. My reply contains no prices or other money terms.
